title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Kiwi Passionfruit Guava delivers a vibrant fusion of tropical fruit flavours. Juicy Kiwi brings a tangy-sweet bite, perfectly balanced by the exotic tartness of Passionfruit and the mellow, aromatic notes of Guava. The result is a bold and refreshing vape with layers of bright, tropical flavour. Blended for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides a satisfying throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. Its 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures excellent flavour clarity and discreet vapour production, making it a great match for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing popular flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
